finalists.label: Organizing pneumonia
finalists.why: It has the most specific findings for it, including bilateral inspiratory crackles and high-resolution CT showing bilateral diffuse ground-glass opacities, with no evidence against it.

finalists.label: Invasive aspergillosis
finalists.why: It is supported by the patient's immunosuppressed state and bilateral inspiratory crackles, although it is not as strongly supported as Organizing pneumonia.

frontier_selector.why: The transbronchial lung biopsy showing alveoli filled with inflammatory debris consisting of granulation tissue, interstitial inflammation, and areas of intra-alveolar fibrin deposition, which is most consistent with Organizing pneumonia.
